label: Demonstration computing facts — may be too familiar for evaluation

facts.meaning: A collection where the last item added is the first item removed (last in, first out).
facts.meaningRubric: Credit an answer that says the most recently added item is removed first, or states last in, first out.

facts.meaning: A collection where the first item added is the first item removed (first in, first out).
facts.meaningRubric: Credit an answer that says items are removed in arrival order, or states first in, first out.

facts.meaning: A fast, usually temporary store of reusable data so later requests can be served more quickly.
facts.meaningRubric: Credit storing a reusable copy of data for faster future access; exact storage technology is unnecessary.

facts.meaning: A function solves a problem by calling itself on smaller cases until a stopping case is reached.
facts.meaningRubric: Credit self-calling on a smaller case and a base or stopping case; either equivalent wording is acceptable.

facts.meaning: Two or more threads cannot proceed because each is waiting for another to release a needed resource.
facts.meaningRubric: Credit mutual or circular waiting that stops all involved threads from progressing.

facts.meaning: A synchronization tool that uses permits to limit how many threads can access a resource at once.
facts.meaningRubric: Credit permits or a counter controlling access to a shared resource; exact implementation detail is unnecessary.
